title: Cinema attendance by age group
instructions: The line graph shows the percentage of people in three age groups in Britain who went to the cinema at least once a month between 1990 and 2020. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
keyOverviewPoints: Young people attended most throughout, but their rate fell sharply after 2000.
Attendance among the 45+ group rose steadily until 2015.
All groups dropped in 2020.

title: Household spending on four categories
instructions: The bar chart compares the proportion of household income spent on housing, food, transport and leisure in four countries in 2022. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
keyOverviewPoints: Housing was the largest expense in every country except Mexico, where food took the biggest share.
Leisure accounted for the smallest proportion everywhere.

title: How students travel to university
instructions: The pie charts show how students at one university travelled to campus in 2005 and 2025. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
keyOverviewPoints: Car use more than halved, losing its position as the most common method.
Cycling tripled; bus became the most popular choice.

title: Internet users in five countries
instructions: The table shows the number of internet users in five countries in 2000, 2010 and 2020. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
keyOverviewPoints: Every country saw growth, but it was far faster in the developing economies.
Germany grew slowly after 2010, while Indonesia overtook Brazil by 2020.

title: How chocolate is made
instructions: The diagram shows the stages in the production of chocolate from cocoa beans. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
processSteps: Ripe cocoa pods are harvested by hand from trees
Beans are removed and left to ferment for about a week
Fermented beans are dried in the sun
Dried beans are packed and shipped to factories
Beans are roasted at high temperature
Shells are removed and the beans are ground into a paste
Sugar and milk are mixed in and the mixture is refined
Liquid chocolate is poured into moulds and cooled
keyOverviewPoints: The process has eight stages, beginning on the farm and ending in the factory.
The first half takes place where the cocoa is grown; the second involves industrial processing.

title: Changes to a seaside village
instructions: The maps show the village of Portwell in 1980 and today. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
keyOverviewPoints: Portwell has changed from a fishing and farming village into a tourist resort.
Most farmland and the dunes have been replaced, though the beach remains.

title: Average house prices in three cities
instructions: The graph shows average house prices in three cities between 2010 and 2024. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
keyOverviewPoints: Prices rose overall in all three cities, most dramatically in Northport.
Southville fell at first before rising steeply after 2018.

title: Hours of sleep by age
instructions: The chart shows the average number of hours men and women in five age groups slept per night in one country. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
keyOverviewPoints: Sleep fell from the youngest group to the middle-aged before recovering in older age.
Differences between men and women were small at every age.

title: Causes of food waste in homes
instructions: The pie chart shows the main reasons why food is thrown away in homes in one European country. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
keyOverviewPoints: Food not being used in time is the leading cause, accounting for over a third.
Taste is the least common reason.

title: Museum visitors by month
instructions: The table shows the number of visitors to three museums in one city during four months of 2023. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
keyOverviewPoints: The Science Museum was the most visited in every month.
July was the busiest month for all three, especially the Science Museum.

title: Recycling glass bottles
instructions: The diagram shows how glass bottles are recycled. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
processSteps: Used bottles are collected from homes and bottle banks
Bottles are taken to a recycling plant
Glass is sorted by colour and cleaned
Clean glass is crushed into small pieces called cullet
Cullet is melted in a furnace with sand and other materials
Molten glass is moulded into new bottles
New bottles are filled and sent to shops
keyOverviewPoints: Recycling glass is a cyclical process with seven stages.
It begins with collection and ends with new bottles returning to shops.

title: Redevelopment of a factory site
instructions: The maps show an old factory site and the plan for its redevelopment. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
keyOverviewPoints: The industrial site will become a residential area with community facilities.
The factory will be replaced by a park at the centre.

title: Rainfall and temperature in Darwin
instructions: The chart shows average monthly rainfall and temperature in the Australian city of Darwin. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
keyOverviewPoints: Darwin has a very wet season and an almost completely dry season.
Temperatures stay warm all year, varying by only about five degrees.

title: Electric car sales
instructions: The graph shows electric cars as a percentage of new car sales in four countries from 2015 to 2024. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
keyOverviewPoints: Norway led throughout and electric cars became almost all new sales there.
China rose fastest after 2019, while Germany fell back after 2021.

title: Reasons for using public libraries
instructions: The chart shows the main reasons why adults and children used public libraries in one city in 2023. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
keyOverviewPoints: Borrowing books was the main reason for both groups.
Children used libraries more for social and study purposes; adults more for computers.

title: Sources of energy used in homes
instructions: The pie charts compare the sources of energy used for heating homes in one country in 1995 and 2025. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
keyOverviewPoints: Gas remained the main source but its share declined.
Heat pumps grew from a tiny share to the second largest, while oil almost disappeared.

title: Employment by sector
instructions: The table shows the percentage of workers employed in agriculture, industry and services in three countries in 1970 and 2020. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
keyOverviewPoints: Agriculture fell sharply in all three countries.
Services became the largest employer everywhere by 2020.

title: Producing olive oil
instructions: The diagram illustrates how olive oil is produced. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
processSteps: Olives are harvested from trees in autumn
Leaves and twigs are removed and the olives are washed
Olives are crushed into a paste, including the stones
The paste is slowly mixed for 30–40 minutes
The paste is spun in a centrifuge to separate oil from water and solids
Oil is left to settle in tanks
keyOverviewPoints: Olive oil production involves seven main stages.
Most of the process is mechanical and no heat is added.

title: Visitors to a national park
instructions: The graph shows the number of visitors to a national park by season between 2016 and 2024. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
keyOverviewPoints: Summer visitors far outnumbered winter visitors throughout.
Both seasons fell sharply in 2020 before recovering to record levels.

title: Water use per person
instructions: The chart shows average daily water use per person for four purposes in two cities. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
keyOverviewPoints: City A used much more water than City B, mainly because of gardens.
Bathing was the largest use in both cities.

title: Changes to a university campus
instructions: The maps show a university campus in 2000 and in 2025. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
keyOverviewPoints: The campus has become more developed, with new housing and research facilities.
The car park has been replaced, and public transport access improved.

title: Population and car ownership
instructions: The chart shows the population of a country and the number of cars per 1,000 people between 1980 and 2020. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
keyOverviewPoints: Car ownership rose much faster than population.
Population growth slowed after 2000, but car ownership kept increasing steadily.

title: Results of a survey on working hours
instructions: The table shows the results of a survey of employees in four industries about their weekly working hours. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
keyOverviewPoints: In every industry, the largest group worked 35–45 hours.
Retail had the most short-hours workers, finance the most long-hours workers.

title: Uses of mobile phones by teenagers
instructions: The pie chart shows how teenagers in one country spent their time on mobile phones in 2024. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
keyOverviewPoints: Social media and video together made up over 60% of phone time.
Schoolwork accounted for only a small fraction.

title: Average life expectancy in four countries
instructions: The graph shows average life expectancy at birth in four countries between 1960 and 2020. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
keyOverviewPoints: Life expectancy rose in all four countries.
Japan moved from second to highest; Nigeria remained lowest despite steady gains.

title: How people travel to work in three cities
instructions: The chart shows the main methods of travelling to work in three cities in 2023. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
keyOverviewPoints: Los Angeles relied overwhelmingly on cars, Tokyo on public transport and Copenhagen on bicycles.
Walking was a minor method everywhere.

title: Household waste composition
instructions: The pie charts show the composition of household waste in one city in 2000 and 2020. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
keyOverviewPoints: Plastic doubled its share, while paper fell sharply.
Food remained the largest category in both years.

title: Top international student destinations
instructions: The table shows the number of international students in five countries in 2005, 2015 and 2023. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
keyOverviewPoints: The USA hosted the most students throughout.
Canada grew most dramatically, overtaking Australia by 2023.

title: How paper is recycled
instructions: The diagram shows the process of recycling paper. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
processSteps: Waste paper is collected from homes and offices
Paper is sorted by type and quality
Paper is mixed with water and chemicals to make pulp
Ink is removed by washing and air bubbles
Pulp is cleaned and screened to remove plastic and staples
Pulp is spread onto a mesh to drain water
Sheets are pressed and dried by heated rollers
New paper is cut into rolls and sent to customers
keyOverviewPoints: Recycling paper involves eight main stages.
The paper is turned into pulp, cleaned and then re-formed into new sheets.

title: How a hydroelectric dam produces electricity
instructions: The diagram shows how electricity is generated at a hydroelectric power station. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
processSteps: Rainwater fills a reservoir behind a dam
Gates open to let water flow into a large pipe
Water flows downhill and gains speed
The turbine drives a generator that produces electricity
Power lines carry electricity to homes and businesses
Water flows out into the river below the dam
keyOverviewPoints: Electricity is generated by the movement of water from a high reservoir to a lower river.
The process is continuous and does not burn fuel.

title: Changes to an airport
instructions: The maps show an airport in 2005 and how it looks today. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
keyOverviewPoints: The airport has expanded significantly, with a second runway and a larger terminal.
Public transport links and new facilities have been added.

title: A town centre before and after pedestrianisation
instructions: The maps show a town centre in 1995 and today. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
keyOverviewPoints: The centre has become pedestrian-friendly, with traffic removed from the main street.
Car-related facilities have been replaced by green space, housing and leisure uses.

title: Ice cream sales and temperature
instructions: The chart shows monthly ice cream sales and average temperature in one city over a year. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
keyOverviewPoints: Ice cream sales closely followed temperature, peaking in July.
Sales were lowest in the coldest months.

title: Smartphone ownership by age
instructions: The graph shows the percentage of people in three age groups who owned a smartphone between 2010 and 2024. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
keyOverviewPoints: Ownership rose sharply in all age groups.
Young adults led throughout, while the oldest group grew most in later years, narrowing the gap.

title: Spending on leisure activities by income group
instructions: The chart shows average monthly spending on four leisure activities by low-, middle- and high-income households. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
keyOverviewPoints: High-income households spent far more on most activities, especially holidays.
Spending on streaming and games was similar across all groups.

title: Energy consumption per person
instructions: The table shows energy consumption per person in five countries in 1990 and 2020. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
keyOverviewPoints: Canada had by far the highest consumption in both years.
China's consumption nearly quadrupled, while Germany's fell.
